review_mode: Assistant visual inspection of original-image overlays; not independent human inter-rater evaluation.

cases.observation: All shifts select original A (mailbox); letters rotate A/B/C/D. All four predicted boxes are identical; GT IoU=0.8737. Consistent correct target and localization.

All shifts select original B (red folder), despite letters B/C/D/A. Every condition is wrong relative to the left-side target. Shift2 narrows the red box to a binder spine; same-choice pairwise box IoU reaches only 0.4015. Order stability of the option ID does not establish physical-region stability.
Original IDs A/B/D/D: pink top, camera, parasol, parasol. The boxes visibly switch entities. Only shift1 selects the camera with GT IoU=0.7656. The changed output is not a mere letter relabeling.
Original B/B/B/D: cat in shifts0/1/2; black laptop in shift3 with GT IoU=0.8369. The changed selection and box also occur among newly generated conditions.

caveats: No identical-input repetitions; numeric/session/cache variations are unquantified.
3028 and 4208 differ only between reused shift0 and the new run; order alone is not isolated.
Five other items vary among new shifts1/2/3, but this is still single-generation evidence.
48 paired conditions are not 48 independent questions; no significance or population claim.
Literal description matching found zero conflicts and zero unmatched descriptions; this is not a proof of correct visual grounding.
Existing choice-position diagnosis, not a novel mechanism or method.
